The introduction of self-reflective mechanisms in RAG frameworks, such as SELF-RAG, further optimizes this process by enabling models to adaptively retrieve relevant information and critique their own outputs, thus reducing factual inaccuracies and enhancing overall generation quality [self-rag:1][self-rag:2]. In the context of de novo molecular design, AI-driven generative models can explore vast chemical spaces to create novel drug-like candidates, thereby circumventing traditional limitations of drug discovery and significantly accelerating the development of new pharmaceuticals [denovo-genai-survey:0][denovo-genai-survey:1].
